initial_branch.name: five_orbit_constants
initial_branch.constraint_gate: Provisional expected p/h constant-mode rows only. Before interpreting a constrained mode, compute exact relation gradients, divide by unordered orbit sizes under a documented derivative convention, and prove the four p-orbit per-edge gradients are exactly equal. Otherwise regroup only exact-gradient-equal orbitals or use the exact total-gradient row.
initial_branch.interpretation: Cheap exact orbital subspace screen only; it does not exhaust the 1248-dimensional coordinate space and substantially overlaps prior orbit-line tests.

production_branch.name: all_fractional_coordinates
production_branch.coordinate_rule: Every unordered off-diagonal parent entry strictly between 0 and Q
production_branch.neutral_projection: Subtract the mean separately inside every recomputed exact integer-gradient class; parent probability equality is not sufficient to merge classes
production_branch.curvature_convention: C2=12*Adj+3*Dis is the t^2 polynomial coefficient; Hessian second derivative is 2*C2
promotion_gates: seventh-degree exclusion from six affine edge factors
at least one feasible holdout recount

matched_control: Immutable parent at q=0 under the same exact evaluator
failure_scope: A five-orbit failure does not address nonconstant modes. A bounded all-coordinate proposal failure is not a PSD certificate.
